project:gpstracker.title: GPSTracker
project:gpstracker.description: A GPS Tracking application that achieves free built-in way by Fused-location method to access location and share it to family via internet.

project:multilangtranscriber.title: MultiLangTranscriber
project:multilangtranscriber.description: A modular FastAPI system for multilingual video translation — extracts audio/frames, uses RAG-enhanced Whisper STT with visual context, refines transcription via LLM, translates with Google Translate, and reconstructs dubbed video.

project:trace.title: TRACE
project:trace.description: An offline-first browser productivity agent built with a Chrome MV3 extension and a local FastAPI backend. Silently watches browser activity, infers intent, and surfaces pending task reminders. All data lives in SQLite with PII stripping baked in.

project:lanfxplorer.title: LANFXplorer
project:lanfxplorer.description: QUIC protocol based P2P FileSharing app. Uses QUIC_API as backend. Can work in LAN/WIFI.

project:sndcpy.title: sndcpy
project:sndcpy.description: OSS contribution enabling GUI and no-debugger mode with wireless audio output on Android.

project:okular.title: okular
project:okular.description: OSS contribution to the KDE document viewer implementing the Async printing option.

project:medcare-ai.title: MedCare AI
project:medcare-ai.description: A production-grade, end-to-end pharmaceutical demand sensing, forecasting, and replenishment optimization platform.

project:galleryclassifier.title: GalleryClassifier
project:galleryclassifier.description: An end-to-end, AI-powered image classification and gallery organization system. Uses a fine-tuned EfficientNet-B0 model exported to ONNX for lightweight CPU inference.

project:workspacetreemaker.title: WorkspaceTreeMaker
project:workspacetreemaker.description: A CLI tool that analyzes Python projects and generates a hierarchical tree of function calls.

cert:aws-ccp.title: AWS Certified Cloud Architect – Practitioner
cert:aws-ccp.description: Validates foundational knowledge of AWS cloud services, architecture principles, security, and cost optimisation strategies.

skill:flutter.title: Flutter

skill:oss.title: Open Source Contribution
skill:oss.description: Navigating large unfamiliar codebases, writing idiomatic patches, and working within community review processes.

skill:linux.title: Linux Systems
skill:linux.description: Deep familiarity with Linux internals — kernel drivers, device configuration, service management, and CLI tooling.

skill:sqlite.title: SQLite
skill:sqlite.description: Embedded, serverless relational database. Used in TRACE for local-first, privacy-preserving storage with PII stripping.

skill:xgboost.title: XGBoost
skill:xgboost.description: Optimized distributed gradient boosting library. Used for demand sensing and forecasting models.

skill:streamlit.title: Streamlit
skill:streamlit.description: Open-source app framework for Machine Learning and Data Science. Used for interactive dashboards.

skill:onnx.title: ONNX (Open Neural Network Exchange)
skill:onnx.description: Open standard for machine learning interoperability. Used for exporting lightweight models for fast inference.

skill:pytorch.title: PyTorch
skill:pytorch.description: Open source machine learning framework. Used for training and fine-tuning deep learning models.

hobby:oss-contrib.description: Active contributor to OSS projects — bug fixes, docs, and small features across several repos including sndcpy and okular.

hobby:homelab.description: Building daily-use applications in a home lab — self-hosting services that don't exist for free in the market.
